WHAT I DO:
I'm co-founder at Wyncode Academy & with the help of an amazing team, I help hundreds of non-coders each year learn how to code and product design in just 10 weeks. We'll show you how to build web applications & also teach you the valuable business & leadership skills you need to succeed as a web developer or product designer. You'll be able to land your dream job with a company that needs your new skills or even use what you've learned to start your own company.

WHO I WORK WITH:
Whether you're a complete beginner, have picked up some coding or design skills over the years or perhaps you've tried teaching yourself online, I'm here to help you learn the most important web development and product design skills faster & help you succeed as a programmer or product designer.

WHY WYNCODE WORKS:
We have a disruptive & immersive education model & do everything possible to help you succeed. This ensures you graduate fully confident in your new skills.

HOW I CAN HELP:
As well as helping to set up Wyncode, I've also represented my country in sport. So I know a bit about the challenges on the road to success. I'd love to help you discover & unlock your hidden potential so you can share your skills with the world & be rewarded in return.

WHAT MAKES ME DIFFERENT:
Together with my team, I've set out to create an environment where you'll be surrounded by highly motivated & inspirational students & instructors looking to make an impact on the universe. Based in the vibrant tech hub of Wynwood Miami, we'll help you make a smooth yet swift transition into the tech industry in a community of students varied in age, background & nationality.

HOW IT WORKS:
To discover how Wyncode could help you step up to the next level on your professional journey, visit: https://wyncode.co/
